Overview

Porto Velho is a city in RO with a population of 548,952. Rondônia’s capital on the Madeira River, a historic rubber boom town turned modern Amazonian economic center. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 80 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
